wikipediaArticleRead.locator: 記事冒頭 L149–152。ベニヤミン族をイスラエルの十二部族の一つとして説明する。
wikipediaArticleRead.support: 冒頭はベニヤミン族をイスラエルの十二部族の一つと定義し、後段で部族史を説明する。今回のプロフィールは個人祖ではなく集団用法に限定。

sourceTextExcerpts.text: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
“Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
